title: OpenAI releases claimed proofs of the quasi-Riemann hypothesis and other open problems
summary: OpenAI published a GitHub collection of manuscripts produced by an unnamed internal model. Headline claims include a zero-free half-plane Re(s) > 7/8 for the Riemann zeta function and all Dirichlet L-functions (the quasi-Riemann hypothesis) with a uniform exclusion of Landau–Siegel zeros, the irrationality exponent of π equal to 2, a negative answer to Hilbert's tenth problem over the rationals, the Kakeya maximal conjecture in three dimensions with full Hausdorff dimension for four-dimensional Kakeya sets, and a uniform bound on limit cycles for Hilbert's sixteenth problem. OpenAI describes the manuscripts as raw research data, not polished papers; Lean formalizations cover selected statements only, and no referee review is reported. The later local-smoothing and Exponential Time Hypothesis results are a separate catalog entry.

evidence.tested: Per the repository's Lean scope notes, formal statements were checked for the 7/8 zero-free half-plane for zeta and every Dirichlet L-function, the uniform logarithmic exclusion region for Landau–Siegel zeros, and the irrationality exponent of π equal to 2; for Hilbert's sixteenth problem only the exact two-cycle bound for quintic Liénard systems is formalized. No Lean formalization is linked for the Hilbert's tenth problem over Q or the Kakeya three- and four-dimensional manuscripts.
evidence.unknown: No referee or independent expert review is reported in the reviewed material. OpenAI states that unformalized results could have issues; on 7 October 2026 it withdrew three Hodge-related manuscripts from the same collection after a sign error. Not all consequences in the papers (for example the Flint–Hills series convergence) are inside the formalized statements.
evidence.ai_role: An unnamed internal OpenAI model produced the manuscripts, at about three hours of ChatGPT Pro thinking compute per result across roughly 4,000 posed problems; the zeta zero-free work did not follow the fixed procedure, and the 11/12 companion write-up was human edited.

source_review.scope: OpenAI announcement, repository README, manuscript map abstracts, release history and Lean scope notes for families 003, 017 and 143; manuscript PDFs not read
